about: The Collect recalls God’s gift of Gregory Nazianzen as minister of eternal salvation. It contrasts his teaching on earth with his intercession in heaven and asks that we be worthy to have him as intercessor.

seg.tr: God, You gave blessed Gregory to Your people as a minister of eternal salvation. Grant, we pray, that we may be worthy to have in heaven, as our intercessor, the one we had on earth as our teacher of life. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, forever and ever.

a.g: we may be worthy to have as intercessor
who lives and reigns with You

ex.w008: The Missal heading identifies Gregory Nazianzen, the bishop and Doctor, rather than another saint named Gregory.
ex.w014: The same Gregory is recalled as a teacher of life on earth and sought as intercessor in heaven.
ex.w022: The prayer asks that we be worthy to have him as intercessor. It does not assert that this has already been earned.
ex.w041: The word “God” refers to the Son, who lives and reigns with the Father in the unity of the Holy Spirit.
